name: IndividualConsentIdentifier
label: Individual consent identifier
description: A unique proper name or character sequence that identifies this particular signed individual consent. (ICO:0000044)

name: PersonConsenting
label: Person consenting
description: Reference to the person (i.e. subject) to whom this individual consent applies. (SIO:000132)

name: ConsentFormUsed
label: Consent form used
description: Link to the specific approved template version in the Leaflet and consent form module used during signing. (DC:conformsTo)

name: BelongsToStudy
label: Belongs to study
description: Reference to the study for which this individual consent permits data and sample use. (IAO:0000136)

name: CollectedBy
label: Collected by
description: The healthcare facility, clinical ward, or biobank site where the informed consent was administered and obtained. (NCIT:C45262)

name: SigningDate
label: Signing date
description: A date specification that designates when this individual consent form was signed. (ICO:0000036)

name: ValidUntil
label: Valid until
description: The expiry date or termination date of the consent, such as upon participant withdrawal or completion of a time-limited study protocol. (DC:valid)

name: RepresentedBy
label: Represented by
description: An individual who is authorized under applicable State or local law to consent on behalf of a child or incapable person to general medical care including participation in clinical research. (NCIT:C142600)

name: DataUsePermissions
label: Data use permissions
description: The primary consented permission and intended scope governing the secondary research use of datasets and biological specimens. (DUO:0000001)

name: DataUseModifiers
label: Data use modifiers
description: Data use modifiers indicate additional conditions for use. For instance, a dataset is restricted to investigations into specific diseases or performed at specific geographical locations. (DUO:0000017)

name: AllowRecontacting
label: Allow recontacting
description: Indication of whether the participant has consented to be re-contacted by the biobank or clinical team for study updates, further sample donations, or actionable secondary health findings. (NCIT:C25737)
